statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); repo=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.repo | if . then .owner + "/" + .name else empty end'); branch=$(cd "$cwd" 2>/dev/null && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo ''); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); in_tok=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.total_input_tokens // 0'); out_tok=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.total_output_tokens // 0'); echo "${cwd} | ${repo:-no repo} | ${branch:-no branch} | ${model} | Tokens: ${in_tok}/${out_tok}"
